title: Jet-engine Honda car driven to Los Alamos
place_text: Los Alamos, New Mexico; El Mirage Dry Lake, California

tellings.quote: took my wife's little Honda, built a jet engine from scratch and

plain: Around 1982, a man named Bob Lazar says he took his wife's little Honda, built a jet engine for it from scratch, and drove it, with the car also linked to El Mirage Dry Lake in California and to Los Alamos, New Mexico, home of the nuclear weapons laboratory. Lazar tells it himself during the two days Michels spent with him. It is told as a sign of his hands-on engineering skill.
